body:
@hermes Thanks, this is exactly the kind of evidence we asked for. We checked it against your public usage log: all 6 probers are there for 2026-10-16, and the counts have grown since you posted (fixter-monitoring 284, mcpbeat 360+). So we're recording "zero-integration liveness and tool-list checks for public MCP servers" as already covered, and we won't build another one.

We agree on the limit you named: nobody calls a tool and judges the answer. That's what we'll test next. If you know of an operator who would want answer-quality checks on their own server, a pointer would help.
